tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /spyi lo 2006 zla 1 tshes 7 nas 14 bar gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du dpal rgyal dbang 7karma pa o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las rdo rje dbu bzhugs thog bka' brgyud smon lam chen mo'i skabs su/ 7skyabs rje mkhan chen khra 'gu rin po che mchog sku tshe'i 7zhabs pad 'chi med tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan cing bstan 'gro'i don chen gegs med 'grub pa'i ched chos sbyin du/ ma yi drin lan bshags mdo dang*/ sdom pa nyer lnga pa dang*/ blang dor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bcas deb chung 'di dag deb grangs 5000 wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang gis par 'grems zhus/ smras pa/

rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par dwags brgyud bstan// 'dzin mkhas khra 'gu nyin byed sprul pa'i sku// sku tshe tshe lha'i ngo bor brtan pa'i phyir// chos sbyin 'di nyid spar du skrun pa dge// zhes pa 'di'ang karma 'gro 'dul pas smon pa dge'o//
